title: Porsche Zuffenhausen warning-strike demonstration over collective wage negotiations
reason: Reuters reports about 4,000 Porsche workers joined a demonstration during a warning strike over wages. IG Metall sought a 7% pay rise from employers in collective bargaining; no evidence that the public gathering demanded a change in state policy. The manual excludes company-specific wage bargaining absent a state-policy target.
notes: A separate Reuters report states around 71,000 workers struck across 370 companies; that distributed strike total is not one simultaneous public gathering and is not treated as the event size. October 28 report is pre-event planning; actual gathering is in the October 29 report.

participants_original.summary: Around 4,000 workers at Porsche Zuffenhausen joined a demonstration (article line 204); nationwide 71,000 is not assigned to this local event.

demands.summary: IG Metall sought 7% pay rises over employer offer during employer/union negotiations (lines 203, 176-177); no state policy demand reported.
